args.question: How do you define digital natives and high engagement?

tool_trajectory.result: Digital natives are defined as customers who have high online or mobile usage ('High' in either category) and have autopay enabled ('Yes'). High engagement is defined as having a Customer Engagement Score (CES) greater than 0.7.

args.sql:
WITH quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        clientref, 
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM scoredate) * 100 + EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM scoredate)) - (tenureyrs / 4) AS cohort_quarter
    FROM 
        core_record
),
digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clientref
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions b
    JOIN 
        expenses_and_assets e ON b.bankexpref = e.expemplref
    JOIN 
        employment_and_income i ON e.expemplref = i.emplcoreref
    JOIN 
        core_record c ON i.emplcoreref = c.coreregistry
    WHERE 
        (b.chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' OR b.chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High')
        AND b.chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes'
),
cohort_engagement AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.cohort_quarter,
        dn.clientref IS NOT NULL AS is_digital_native,
        COUNT(cr.clientref) AS cohort_size,
        AVG(ces.ces) AS avg_engagement_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ces.ces > 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(cr.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ces.ces > 0.7 AND dn.clientref IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN dn.clientref IS NOT NULL THEN cr.clientref END), 0) AS high_engagement_percentage_digital_native
    FROM 
        quarterly_cohorts qc
    JOIN 
        core_record cr ON qc.clientref = cr.clientref
    LEFT JOIN 
        digital_natives dn ON cr.clientref = dn.clientref
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            c.coreregistry AS clientref, 
            ext."Customer Engagement Score (CES)" AS ces
        FROM 
            core_record c
        CROSS JOIN 
            all_external_knowledge ext
    ) ces ON cr.clientref = ces.clientref
    GROUP BY 
        qc.cohort_quarter, dn.clientref IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter,
    is_digital_native,
    cohort_size,
    avg_engagement_score,
    high_engagement_percentage,
    high_engagement_percentage_digital_native
FROM 
    cohort_engagement;

digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clientref
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions b
    JOIN 
        expenses_and_assets e ON b.bankexpref = e.expemplref
    JOIN 
        employment_and_income i ON e.expemplref = i.emplcoreref
    JOIN 
        core_record c ON i.emplcoreref = c.coreregistry
    WHERE 
        (b.chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' OR b.chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High')
        AND b.chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes'
),
cohort_engagement AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.cohort_quarter,
        dn.clientref IS NOT NULL AS is_digital_native,
        COUNT(cr.clientref) AS cohort_size,
        AVG(ces.ces) AS avg_engagement_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ces.ces > 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(cr.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ces.ces > 0.7 AND dn.clientref IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN dn.clientref IS NOT NULL THEN cr.clientref END), 0) AS high_engagement_percentage_digital_native
    FROM 
        quarterly_cohorts qc
    JOIN 
        core_record cr ON qc.clientref = cr.clientref
    LEFT JOIN 
        digital_natives dn ON cr.clientref = dn.clientref
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            c.coreregistry AS clientref, 
            ext."Customer Engagement Score (CES)" AS ces
        FROM 
            core_record c
        CROSS JOIN 
            all_external_knowledge ext
    ) ces ON cr.clientref = ces.clientref
    GROUP BY 
        qc.cohort_quarter, dn.clientref IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter,
    is_digital_native,
    cohort_size,
    avg_engagement_score,
    high_engagement_percentage,
    high_engagement_percentage_digital_native
FROM 
    cohort_engagement;

WITH quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        clientref, 
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM scoredate) * 100 + EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM scoredate)) - (tenureyrs / 4) AS cohort_quarter
    FROM 
        core_record
),
digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clientref
    FROM

    JOIN

        (b.chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' OR b.chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High')

),
cohort_engagement AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.cohort_quarter,
        dn.clientref IS NOT NULL AS is_digital_native,
        COUNT(cr.clientref) AS cohort_size,
        AVG(ces.ces) AS avg_engagement_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ces.ces > 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(cr.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ces.ces > 0.7 AND dn.clientref IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN dn.clientref IS NOT NULL THEN cr.clientref END), 0) AS high_engagement_percentage_digital_native
    FROM 
        quarterly_cohorts qc
    JOIN

    JOIN (

        FROM

    ) ces ON cr.clientref = ces.clientref
    GROUP BY

)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter,
    is_digital_native,
    cohort_size,
    avg_engagement_score,
    high_engagement_percentage,
    high_engagement_percentage_digital_native
FROM 
    cohort_engagement;
